reviews.subject: fix(cdk/stepper): allow signal form to be assigned as stepControl (#33562)
reviews.decision: The complete original seven-path production/API/demo patch is reviewed individually. Its callable Field branch adds modern signal-form support; this does not authorize copying a CDK stepper or a modern legacy API mirror, and that branch is absent at21.2.14 minimum. The noncallable AbstractControl valid/invalid/pending/reset logic retains the original16 contract: invalid/pending controls block linear navigation, valid controls complete/advance, and reset clears interaction/error/completion and form state while selecting zero. Those expectations were read from untouched CDK16.2.14, not generated from the candidate. A real public MatStepper with FormControl in the packed legacy consumer executes all four transitions and selection events[1,0] on both exact minimum CDK/Material peers; both78-case packed-consumer checks pass. Do not adopt the modern Field API or fork the ordinary stepper into the add-on. This is a bounded disposition of this patch and its classic-control path, not full stepper accessibility/motion/signal-form support, all consumer floors or G11 qualification.
reviews.behavior_qualification: Bounded classic AbstractControl transitions pass on both minimum component peers; standalone packed consumer78 passes both lines. Broader gates incomplete.
